verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents a public RESTful API for directory, device, onboarding/offboarding, and event-export operations. A published API 2.0 spec (index.yaml) describes Graph traversal endpoints, and the product also offers a PowerShell module and an official GitHub repo of API examples. The probes failing at standard OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the spec is hosted at /api/2.0/index.yaml. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API, and spec discovery at standard OpenAPI paths for machine consumers.
